name: Haliskia
sum: ‘Sea phantom’: a large anhanguerian from the Albian Toolebuc Formation of Queensland — the most complete pterosaur from Australia.
wsnote: Estimated 4.6 m from proportions of Arthurdactylus.
holotype: KK F1426 — Toolebuc Formation, near Richmond, Queensland (found 2021).
material: Partial skeleton (~22%): front of skull with partial crest, mandible, teeth, vertebrae, ribs, scapulocoracoid, limb bones.
biology: Skeletally mature; lived over the Eromanga inland sea. Like other anhanguerians it was probably a fish-eater.
author: Pentland et al. 2024
